title: Street food sizzle
prompt_en: Vertical 9:16 handheld shot at a night market stall. A cook flips skewers on a flaming grill, sparks rising, smoke catching neon signs. Camera slowly pushes in toward the grill. Bokeh crowd in background, saturated reds and teal, energetic mood.
prompt_zh: 竖屏 9:16 手持镜头，夜市摊位。摊主在明火烤架上翻动烤串，火星上升，烟雾映着霓虹招牌。镜头缓慢推近烤架。背景人群虚化，饱和的红与青色调，热闹氛围。
why_it_works: Combines a clear action, a single camera move and a lighting palette, which are the three things most video models follow best.
result_check: Hands and skewers stay coherent while flipping
Neon text, if any, is not required to be readable
